DOMAIN: §3pp3–5 distinguishes possible concrete facts/events/states of affairs from propositions, fixes the possible-facts domain, and states T with Barcan/converse-Barcan. Fact aggregates are not arbitrary individual-bearer fusions by their names. §7Corollary1pp9–10 separately assumes every fact involves some being/property and involvement in an actual fact implies actual bearer existence; source fact-to-individual/rigid witness interpretation remains an added semantic obligation, not automatic necessity of a concrete individual or God. FUSION/CF1: §3p3Axiom2 is type aggregation; §3p4Axiom4 is BOXED whole-obtaining→part-obtaining, stronger than merely local part existence. §8.5p16 explicitly treats nonempty wholly-contingent-fact aggregation as the crucial global commitment and argues that basic concrete fact totalities avoid problematic higher-order totalities. This is positive source argument, not a mechanically established actual selected-sum/type or possible-fact-to-individual dictionary. In §6.2p8Lemma2 the selected aggregate of necessary parts is introduced and the contingent original is then said not to be part of it; the source does not separately display the selected aggregate’s necessity. Our SelectedNecessaryPartsFusionAt remains an explicit analyst warrant; it is not independently discharged by local A5, nor should absence of a displayed step be reported as a refutation of every charitable reconstruction. Axiom4 does support the shape of modal downward necessity used by source Lemma1, but its world/domain correspondence still needs a separate application. NONOVERLAP/CF5: §4p5Axiom6 motivates nonoverlap through Hume’s separate-existences insight, precision in fact mereology, and expressly excludes only shared FACT parts, not spatial/temporal overlap. No additional independent derivation of this universal nonoverlap restriction was found in the read argument/objections. Numerical inequality or ordinary body separation is not silently substituted. CAUSALCOVERAGE/CF3: §4pp5–6Axiom7 states universal wholly-contingent-fact causal coverage; §5.1p6 admits empirical evidence cannot settle all exceptions and argues at least a DEFAULT license absent positive contrary evidence. §5.2pp6–7 offers empirical-success/non-gerrymandered-class and skepticism arguments; §8.1p13 rejects requiring observations of universes specifically and defends default application to the cosmos. These are source arguments to assess, not a proof of exceptionless CF3 or automatic defeat of the strongest domain/reference-class rival. Rejected reading: purely heuristic inquiry norm as the author’s full thesis, since §5.2 expressly defends descriptive reality. Also rejected: defeasibility alone as proof of explanatory adequacy or complete proof that a relevant exception exists. NONNECESSITATION: §4pp5–6 expressly denies that causes must be modally sufficient; §8.3pp14–15 distinguishes causing observations from explaining every correlation. §8.4pp15–16 represents agent-power/patient-liability facts as at least part of a cause and allows failed exercise with unchanged cause/concomitants. No whole-ground necessitation or collapse principle follows. §8.9pp17–19 separately proposes effect-to-cause identity/relative-necessity reasoning, not cause-to-effect necessitation; its merits remain open. Theorem1p9’s reference to Axiom1 as Veridicality is a numbering mismatch with §4’s Axiom5, retained as a locator issue rather than silently rewritten.
